summary: Backend regression suite executed against external REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL for Franklin Wardcorpp CRM. 49/49 pytest tests passed covering auth (5 roles, Bearer + cookie), users + role hierarchy, visits (scope + GPS), POCs, follow-ups + overdue flag + escalation (manager+), deals/kanban (stage filters + touchpoints + WON notification), products (RBAC), bills (GST + discount needs_approval), dashboard (overview/performance/funnel/agent-locations/top-products), notifications (list/mark-read/mark-all-read), and reports (visits/bills/pipeline/pocs). SpringEdge SMS/WhatsApp confirmed mocked (logs only).
action_items: Consider: CORSMiddleware uses allow_origins=['*'] with allow_credentials=True - browsers reject this combination. If frontend ever needs to send cookies cross-origin, switch to explicit origins from CORS_ORIGINS env.
Consider: No brute-force lockout after N failed logins (playbook recommends 5). Not blocking but a hardening gap.

Consider: salesperson can DELETE /api/deals/{id} for any deal (no scope check inside delete_deal). Currently passes because tests don't exercise cross-user deletes, but a salesperson could delete another's deal if they guess the id.
Consider: PATCH /api/deals/{id} has no salesperson scope check either - same risk as above.
Consider: GET /api/users/{user_id} returns any user regardless of actor role/scope (no hierarchy check).
critical_code_review_comments: RBAC scope gap: update_deal / delete_deal / get_user have no actor-scope enforcement; only list endpoints are scoped. A salesperson with a known UUID could mutate/delete another user's deal.
CORS misconfig: allow_origins=['*'] with allow_credentials=True is non-spec-compliant; CORS_ORIGINS env value is read but unused.

scoped_user_filter only handles 'salesperson' - sales_manager is treated identically to ceo/admin for visits/pocs/deals/bills (sees ALL data). Likely unintended; manager should see only their direct reports' records.
Monthly-revenue bucket uses (today - 30*i days) which drifts on month boundaries; could be replaced with proper month math.
server.py is 883 lines (>700) - consider splitting into routers (auth/users/visits/deals/bills/dashboard) for maintainability.
test_credentials: Used seeded creds from /app/memory/test_credentials.md (ceo/admin/manager/sales1/sales2). All login successful, bcrypt hashes verified, httpOnly cookie 'access_token' set on login.
seed_data_creation: Tests created TEST_-prefixed users (deleted in cleanup), 1 TEST visit, 1 TEST POC, 2 TEST followups, 1 TEST deal (moved to WON), 1 TEST product (deleted), 2 TEST bills. Some TEST data remains in collections (visits/pocs/followups/deals/bills) but is clearly tagged with TEST_ prefix.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend is fully green. Full pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py can be re-run with: pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v. Frontend not yet tested. Note the RBAC scope gaps in mutate-by-id endpoints (PATCH/DELETE deals, GET user-by-id) - not exercised here but worth covering when fixed. SpringEdge writes to db.sms_logs (MOCKED_SENT).
